map.📚 深度解析：基坑主动土压力估算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: excavation active earth pressure estimate (civil)
map.地铁/地下室深基坑：沿深度分层算 Ka、叠加地面超载 q，得作用在支挡结构的梯形: Deep excavations for metro or basement projects: compute Ka layer by layer down the depth and add the ground surcharge q, giving a trapezoidal pressure distribution on the retaining structure.
map.支撑轴力估算：取某工况土压力合力，按支点数分配每道支撑轴力。: Strut axial force estimate: take the earth pressure resultant for a stage and distribute it across the struts to get each strut force.
map.水位与降水：水土分算/合算选择影响土压力，软土地区需谨慎。: Water level and dewatering: the choice between separate and combined soil-water calculation changes the earth pressure, so be careful in soft ground.
map.均质土基坑土压力分布: Earth pressure distribution for a uniform soil excavation
map.γ=19kN/m³、φ=20°、c=10kPa、H=8m、地面超载 q=20kP: With γ = 19 kN/m³, φ = 20°, c = 10 kPa, H = 8 m and surcharge q = 20 kPa: Ka ≈ 0.49. The surcharge adds p = Ka·q ≈ 9.8 kPa at the top and pa ≈ Ka·γH − 2c√Ka + Ka·q ≈ 0.49 × 19 × 8 − 2 × 10 × 0.7 + 9.8 ≈ 64 kPa at the base, a trapezoidal distribution.
map.砂土、粉土宜水土分算（水压力单列）；黏性土常合算（用浮重度计入）；选择错误会高估: Sandy and silty soils are usually calculated separately with water pressure listed on its own. Cohesive soils are often combined using the submerged unit weight. The wrong choice either over- or under-estimates the lateral pressure.
map.地面堆载 q 乘 Ka 作为附加均布压力叠加到各深度土压力上，临近基坑边的堆载尤: Multiply the ground surcharge q by Ka to get an additional uniform pressure superposed on the earth pressure at every depth. Piling material close to the excavation edge is especially dangerous.
map.支撑道数影响土压力吗？: Does the number of struts affect the earth pressure?
map.不影响土压力分布本身，但影响每道支撑分担与位移；多道支撑减小单道轴力与墙体变形。: It does not change the pressure distribution itself, but it affects how much each strut carries and the deflection. More struts reduce the axial force per strut and the wall movement.
